review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines only private helpers (an equivalence for the empty index, a section of the quotient map, and a closed-under-isomorphisms fact about integrality), plus instances and lemmas that apply Mathlib notions: IsDomain, IsIntegral, GeometricallyIntegral, pullbackSpecIso and the tensor and localization equivalences. It introduces no competing concept. I grepped Mathlib's AlgebraicGeometry directory for an existing IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms instance for IsIntegral and found none. That helper would be a theorem duplication in any case, which the rubric excludes. I did not review the GL and SL coordinate ring definitions, because they are in other files.
